Both balls and boxes are indistinguishable, so we count partitions of 5 into at most 2 parts: (5,0), (4,1), (3,2). That gives 3 ways.

- Solution 1 counts 21 arrangements using stars and bars with the wrong setup, so it is wrong.
- Solution 2 lists 4 cases, but it counts (3,2) and (2,3) as different even though they are the same once the boxes are swapped, so it is wrong.
- Solution 3 counts 6 ordered distributions, so it is wrong.

The correct answer is 3, which none of the solutions give.

CHOICE: NONE
